name: Orcus Underpriest

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Blessing of Orcus
traits.details: allies in the area gain death strike.

traits.name: Closer to Orcus
traits.details: While bloodied, the Orcus underpriest gains a +2 bonus to melee attack rolls and a +3 bonus to melee damage rolls.

auras.name: Blessing of Orcus
auras.details: allies in the area gain death strike.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target has a -2 AC until the end of the Orcus underpriest's next turn

effect.description: Target ally within 5 squares gains a +5 bonus to attack rolls until the end of its next turn. In addition, the target heals 10hp.
Before he dies, the Orcus underpriest can make a basic melee or ranged attack against a target within reach.
